instruction: Open the annual enterprise survey spreadsheet, export it as a PDF file, and save it to the Desktop as 'enterprise-survey.pdf'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the annual enterprise survey XLSX file in LibreOffice Calc, exporting it to PDF format, and saving as 'enterprise-survey.pdf' on Desktop. Evaluator checks if the file exists at the expected location.
metadata.verification: Verified that PDF export to 'enterprise-survey.pdf' is a standard LibreOffice Calc export option. File existence check is appropriate for this task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter performs comprehensive file validation: existence, MIME type (application/pdf), file size, freshness (within 5 minutes), and LibreOffice creator metadata
Metric correctly validates all critical properties: file exists, is a valid PDF, is not empty (>=100 bytes), and is fresh
Freshness check (5-minute window) effectively prevents false positives from old files
Task config includes pre-task file removal (rm -f) to prevent false positives from previous runs
Evaluator covers all instruction requirements: open spreadsheet, export as PDF, save to Desktop with correct filename
Correct parameter handling: metric does not misuse expected parameter (no incorrect expected.get('rules') pattern)
Logic is sound and will work correctly at runtime
